Dexter took one look at a standard alchemist's flamethrower, muttered something unrepeatable about brass sockets, and rebuilt it. A recalibrated pressure regulator and a wider-bore muzzle let the wielder shape the burst with their own alchemical precision instead of leaving everything to the raw potency of the fuel. Two vials of alchemist's fire are still loaded into the sockets at the base of the weapon, and the tubes must be cleaned and primed; properly loading the flamethrower in this way takes 1 minute. When the trigger on a loaded flamethrower is pulled, the alchemist's fire is siphoned into the rifle and shot out of the muzzle in a line of fire. The size of the burst is determined by the strength of the weakest alchemist's fire loaded into the flamethrower.

Activate 2 (fire, manipulate)

Requirements The flamethrower is loaded

Effect You pull the trigger, expending both loaded alchemist's fires to shoot a line of fire. Creatures in the area take fire damage based on the weakest alchemist's fire loaded into the flamethrower, as noted below. The basic Reflex save DC is equal to your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Creatures that critically fail the save additionally take the listed persistent fire damage.

  • Lesser Alchemist's Fire: The flamethrower deals @Damage[2d8[fire]|options:area-damage] (@Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect]) in a @Template[line|distance:30]. @Damage[1[persistent,fire]] damage.
  • Moderate Alchemist's Fire: The flamethrower deals @Damage[4d8[fire]|options:area-damage] (@Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect]) in a @Template[line|distance:60]. @Damage[2[persistent,fire]] damage.
  • Greater Alchemist's Fire: The flamethrower deals @Damage[7d8[fire]|options:area-damage] (@Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect]) in a @Template[line|distance:90]. @Damage[3[persistent,fire]] damage.
  • Major Alchemist's Fire: The flamethrower deals @Damage[10d8[fire]|options:area-damage] (@Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect]) in a @Template[line|distance:120]. @Damage[4[persistent,fire]] damage.
